        @NameInMap(value="ApplicationType")
public String applicationType

        The application type. Valid values:

        • PC_WebSite: web application.
        • Mini_Program: mini program. If this parameter is not specified or left empty, applications are not filtered by type. For compatibility, historical missing, NULL, or empty types are treated as PC_WebSite.

        PC_WebSite
